subject: Co-sell enablement & publisher onboarding: FinTechX offer - technical validation & procurement path
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Azure Marketplace Support <azure-pub-support@microsoft.com>, Marketplace Partner Ops <partner-ops@contoso.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, John Doe <john.doe@fintechx.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Co-sell enablement & publisher onboarding: FinTechX offer - technical validation & procurement path

Hi team,

Looping in Marketplace and Contoso partner ops as we begin publisher onboarding for FinTechX's SaaS offer. FinTechX is targeting co-sell certification and transactable listing in the US region; procurement will likely flow through EA (large enterprise customer) and Microsoft CSP channels.

Quick context: FinTechX is an account aggregation and payments orchestration platform; they want a transactable SaaS offer (metered subscription + optional add-on SKUs). We ran a sandbox smoke earlier this week and need to move to formal technical validation and publisher proofing.

Action items we need clarified from Marketplace team:
- Required artifacts for publisher tenant proofing (exact doc types + acceptable id formats).
- Preferred offer manifest format for our CI/CD (are you validating SaaSOfferManifest.json v2 or v3?).
- Identity flow recommendations: SAML vs OIDC for SSO claims mapping; any specific claim names expected for Enterprise EA purchases?
- Transactable SKU guidance (billing center, sample pricing JSON, and expected SKU metadata).
- Target window for technical validation (we'd like a 2-day slot next week for automated smoke + manual acceptance).

I've attached a short onboarding pack with the manifest and a network diagram showing outbound webhooks and callback URIs. Also including the first draft of the SaaS offer manifest.

Attachments: publisher_onboarding_pack.pdf (summary), network_diagram.png (diagram), SaaSOfferManifest.json (draft manifest)

Can you confirm the preferred validation window and any pre-checks to run so we pass on the first attempt? If helpful, propose two slots and we'll confirm with FinTechX.

Thanks,
--
Priyom Das
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Azure Marketplace Support <azure-pub-support@microsoft.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marketplace Partner Ops <partner-ops@contoso.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, John Doe <john.doe@fintechx.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 11:40:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Co-sell enablement & publisher onboarding: FinTechX offer - technical validation & procurement path

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the clear summary and for sending the artifacts. We've reviewed the attachments at a high level; next steps and required items are below. Please treat this as our standard publisher onboarding checklist + a few FinTechX-specific notes.

Required items for tenant proofing:
- Publisher legal entity proof (incorporation docs or DUNS) and matching Payout contact.
- Verified Publisher Azure AD tenant id and a service principal for integration testing (client id + cert or client secret).
- Company-authenticated email domain; a console screenshot showing domain verification helps speed the process.

Offer manifest + format:
- We currently validate SaaSOfferManifest.json v3 for transactable SaaS offers in the portal. Your draft is mostly compliant; we need SKU metadata fields for BillingDimension and MeteringDimensions expanded. See portal schema docs: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Marketplace/PublisherPortal (manifest schema section).

Identity and SSO claims:
- OIDC is preferred for modern SSO flows; for EA purchases we rely on claim 'email' and 'upn' for account mapping. If SAML is required, include NameID and email claim mapping.

Procurement and co-sell registration:
- For co-sell enablement, register the deal in the Co-sell portal and provide a HubSpot or CRM ID. We'll request the Microsoft seller alias (M365 ID) for invoicing.
- Transactable offers require price list and invoice terms; provide sample pricing CSV and indicate whether you want monthly or annual billing cycles.

Test slots and validation scope:
- We can allocate a technical validation window next week on either Tue 15 Dec 2026 10:00-12:00 PT or Wed 16 Dec 2026 14:00-16:00 PT. Each session includes automated smoke tests (connectivity, health endpoints, webhook delivery) and a short manual acceptance run.

Pre-checks to run locally (recommended):
1) Confirm manifest schema v3 passes validator (we can share the validator link).
2) Ensure the service principal can request tokens for the offer subscription and simulate a purchase flow using sandbox EA credentials.
3) Expose a /health and a /webhook/ack endpoint with documented responses; automated tests will call these.

FinTechX-specific notes:
- Because this is a payments orchestration product, please provide the security questionnaire excerpt covering PCI scope and whether cardholder data touches your environment. We'll route that to our compliance reviewer.
- For listing copy and co-sell collateral, we need a short 50-100 word description and 2-3 benefit bullets targeted at ISV customers.

Please confirm which validation slot you prefer and attach the updated manifest + proofing documents. If you'd like, we can provision a short-lived sandbox EA tenancy for testing during the session.

Regards,
Azure Marketplace Support
azure-pub-support@microsoft.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Azure Marketplace Support <azure-pub-support@microsoft.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, John Doe <john.doe@fintechx.com>, Marketplace Partner Ops <partner-ops@contoso.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Dec 2026 07:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Co-sell enablement & publisher onboarding: FinTechX offer - technical validation & procurement path

Appreciate the quick turnaround — thanks.

We prefer Tue 15 Dec 2026 10:00-12:00 PT for the validation window. I've attached an updated SaaSOfferManifest.json (v3) with expanded BillingDimension entries, and a redacted incorporation doc and domain verification screenshot in the onboarding pack. Also attaching a short PCI scoping summary prepared by FinTechX.

Answers to the quick questions:
- Pricing: FinTechX wants monthly metered billing with a base monthly subscription SKU plus two add-on SKUs measured by API calls. Pricing CSV attached inside the onboarding pack.
- Identity: FinTechX will support OIDC; they will provide a test client and redirect URI for the session.
- Procurement path: Primary is EA; secondary CSP is possible for SMB customers. We'll register the deal in our CRM (HubSpot ID FTX-2392) and will share the Microsoft seller alias once provided.

Prep plan for Tue 15: (owners in parentheses)
- Manifest validation and syntax check (Redwood)
- Service principal/token smoke test (FinTechX)
- Automated webhook and health-run (Azure test harness)
- Manual acceptance (Marketplace engineer + Redwood solutions engineer)

Request: can Marketplace provision a short-lived sandbox EA tenancy or provide sandbox EA credentials for the automated purchase simulation? That will reduce friction on the day. Also please share the manifest validator link you mentioned.

Next steps: Confirm slot (we're locking internal calendars), supply sandbox EA details if available, and we'll run the local pre-checks you listed.

Thanks,
--
Priyom Das
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

On Sat, 11 Dec 2026 at 15:40 +0000, Azure Marketplace Support <azure-pub-support@microsoft.com> wrote:

>
